name: Sterling
description: A friendly, witty young American man in his late twenties with a warm, clear, articulate voice. Energetic and engaging storyteller, like a popular YouTube explainer host who makes money and history fun. Natural conversational pacing, confident, with a smile in his voice. Studio-quality recording, no background noise.
sample: In 1324, one man walked into Cairo with so much gold... that he accidentally crashed the economy. Hi, I'm Sterling, and today we're finding out how being too rich can actually break an economy. Trust me, this story is wild.
